expectation_results.expectation: The output contains a capability_concept_graph inside a stage S3 handoff envelope with a focus question and typed concept/procedure/strategy/representation/metacognition nodes rather than only topic headings.
expectation_results.evidence: Field is named capability_concept_map (not capability_concept_graph); no focus_question field (only a goal headline and G3 title); legend defines only 'capability' and 'concept' types — no procedure/strategy/representation/metacognition nodes appear anywhere.

expectation_results.expectation: The directed prerequisite edges form an acyclic structure (a DAG) and the hard-prerequisite subgraph contains no cycle.
expectation_results.evidence: prereq edges (CON-3→CON-5→CON-1; CON-4→CON-5; CON-7→CON-8→{CON-9,CON-10}→CON-12) and depends edges (CAP-2→3→4→5→6, CAP-7→8) admit a topological order with no back-edge; acyclic by inspection.

expectation_results.expectation: Every hard prerequisite edge carries an explicit rationale, and soft edges are distinguished from hard edges.
expectation_results.evidence: Every prereq edge has only {from,to,relation:'prereq'} — no rationale/why field; no strength:hard|soft attribute anywhere, so soft edges are not distinguished from hard edges.

expectation_results.expectation: Every target capability traces to the nodes required to diagnose and assess it.
expectation_results.evidence: Each capability lists supporting 'concepts', giving partial diagnostic trace, but there are no dedicated diagnostic/assessment nodes and zero assessment items exist, so no capability can trace to nodes 'required to assess it'.

expectation_results.expectation: Every key node has an observable capability statement plus at least one assessment item, and misconceptions and mastery thresholds are present.
expectation_results.evidence: Capabilities have descriptions but no assessment items on any node; no misconception fields anywhere; a mastery_scale and per-node mastery/score exist but no explicit mastery thresholds (target cutoffs) are defined.

expectation_results.expectation: Full traceability links each node to S1 goal capabilities, S2 audited evidence, and assessment items, and G3 passes with a deterministic route to S4 only when all graph invariants hold.
expectation_results.evidence: No per-node links to S1 capabilities; only some capabilities mention S2 in free-text 'evidence' (concept nodes do not); no assessment items to link; next_after_g3/S4 route is gated on report review, not on graph-invariant checks.

summary: Rich capability/concept map, but it lacks required typed nodes, a focus question, edge rationales, hard/soft edge distinction, assessment items, misconceptions, mastery thresholds, and explicit S1/S2/assessment traceability with an invariant-gated S4 route.
